tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// cho ga'i sngon 'gro sems bskyed sdom chog len tshul bzhugs so//

cho ga'i sngon 'gro sems bskyed sdom chog len tshul ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// nas / rnam dag zhing du skye bar shog / ces pa'i bar brjod/ ngan 'gro las ni zlog bgyid cing*// mtho ris lam ni rab ston la// rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa// byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo// gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen te// skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing*// gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi// de nas sa gzhi byin rlabs ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ deng 'dir khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa lta bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pas mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā brtā ya a brtā ya ho badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ mchod pa byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing 'di dag tu lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya la sogs pa rnam par dag cing yid du 'ong ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo= sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya dang bcas mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs brjod/ de nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ phyogs dus kun nas skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs te// dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol/ /zhes dang*/

ma lus sems can= sogs nas/ bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/ chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*// nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che// dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi// zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa// dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs// chos dang ye shes chags bral ba// kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan// tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi dag la// thub pa skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen// shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa= sogs nas/ thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// pad+ma kā ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che// dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyis// sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin byin rlabs pa// bka' drin chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa dang bzhi pa gang rung dang*/ rgya gar skad du/ e ka gā thā/ bod skad du/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// skyes bu khyu mchog khyed 'dra'i dge sbyong chen po gzhan dag lha yul sa la'ang med// 'jig rten 'di na'ang yod pa ma yin rnam thos bu yi gnas na'ang yod ma yin// lha yi pho brang gnas mchog dag na'ang med la phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dag na'ang med// ri dang nags su bcas pa'i sa steng rgyas pa kun tu bskor kyang ga la yod// tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa rdzogs so// ༈ rgya gar skad du/ tsa tu rgā thā/ bod skad du/ tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// skur gyur pa ni thams cad la'ang*// mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis mnga' ba'i// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzogs sangs gang du bltams pa dang*// gang du byang chub la reg dang*// zhi ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// zag med mya ngan 'das pa dang*// bde gshegs gang du bzhugs pa dang*// 'chag pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang*// seng ge lta bur gzims pa yi// gnas de la ni bdag phyag 'tshal// steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang*//

phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang*// skur bcas sku ni med pa yi// mchod rten la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rkang gnyis dam pa shar dang ni// byang gi phyogs char bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba bsten dka' zhes bya ba// des ni tshigs bcad 'di gsungs so// gang gi tshigs bcad 'di bzhi yi// de bzhin gshegs pa bstod byed na// bskal pa bye ba stong du ni// de ni ngan 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi dang por byang chub thugs bskyed nas// sogs/ bde bar gshegs pa khyed sku= sogs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa= sogs nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// zhes dang*/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod// oṃ badz+ra bhu mi/ sogs nas maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing*// sogs/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyis mchod// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid yongs bzhes nas// bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes dang*/ mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di 'bul bas/ /sogs nas/ 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog /me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sogs nas/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// zhes dang*/ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// bdag gi sgo gsum gtan du dbul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// bdag ni khyod kyi yongs su bzung bas na// srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyi// sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing*// sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do// zhes dang*/ u hu hu lags/

bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po/ sogs jo bshags dang*/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad= sogs ltung bshags brjod/ de nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug sogs nas/ phyir bsngo'o// zhes pa'i bar brjod/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang = sogs/ btang snyoms chen po'i ngang la sems rab tu gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi po 'don bsgom bsgrags/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// phangs pa med par btang bar bya// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang*/ sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ zhes dang*/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// zhes sbrel ba lan gsum/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// long bas phyag dar phung po las// ji ltar rin chen rnyed pa ltar// de bzhin ji zhig ltar stes nas// byang chub sems ni bdag la skyes// zhes dang*/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyi// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis//

zhes dang*/ byang chub sems mchog rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog / zhes dang*/ byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*// byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing*// bdud kyi las rnams spong bar shog / zhes dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni// 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa// sems can rnams la'ang de 'byor shog / zhes dang*/ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stong par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub par shog / ༈ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ oṃ a mo gha shī la/ saṃ bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shud+dha satwa/ pad+ma bi bhu ṣi te bhu dza/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a wa lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum brjod/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig nyon mongs pas tshul khrims 'chal ba las byung ba'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims kyi skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig nyon mongs pas mi brdzi bar rnam par grol ba'i bde ba la gnas par gyur cig khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*// sogs nas/ phyin rdzogs shog rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su= sogs nas/ spyod par shog bar brjod/ ༈ de nas/ hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang*// sogs lan gsum/ e ma ho/ spros bral chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams su// sogs bla ma sku gsum gyi gsol 'debs dang*/ chos sku kun tu bzang po'i= sogs/ rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/

zhes dang*/ 'di ltar mig gi yul du snang ba yi// sogs nas/ bdag 'dra'i rang rgyud grol bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes dang*/ de nas/ 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang*// thugs rje lung rtogs mnyam pa'i mthu mnga' yang*// nags khrod dam par sbas pa'i btul zhugs kyis// 'khor 'das chos skur rdzogs pa'i klong chen pa// dri med 'od zer zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// shes bya kun mkhyen 'gro la rjes brtse'i gter// dri med 'od zer yang sprul thugs gter mdzod// 'od gsal klong chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// 'jigs med gling pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'phags pa'ajig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i 'phrul// 'gro ba thar gling bgrod pa'i ded dpon mchog /'brel tshad donaldan klong chen rnal 'byor pa// 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gur gsol ba 'debs// phyi ltar rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lha// nang ltar grub pa'i dbang phyug sha ba ri// gsang ba 'phags mchog sdug bsngal rang grol dngos// 'jigs med chos kyi dbang por gsol ba 'debs// chos brgyad mdud pa ro snyoms ngang du zhig /blos byas ri mo ka dag dbyings su yal// rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs mngon sum gzigs// lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi mar gsol ba 'debs// yon tan sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam na yang*// bka' drin sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i mgon// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gnas lugs rtogs pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs// de nas rang gzhung gi gsol 'debs la 'jug go /mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos dpal sprul rin po che'i gsung rgyun ltar bkod pa'o/// /
